name: Momentic
description: Tests web, iOS and Android apps with AI: write, run and repair end-to-end tests as YAML in your repo from the CLI or a coding agent over MCP. For engineering and QA teams.

skills.name: Write Tests
skills.description: Writes Momentic end-to-end tests as YAML files in your repository from a coding agent, guided by the momentic-test skill.

skills.name: Preview & Run Steps
skills.description: Previews and runs test steps in a live browser or device session and returns screenshots so the agent can check each step.

skills.name: Repair Failing Tests
skills.description: Reads a structured failure with the failed step, screenshot and trace, then fixes the test file and runs it again.

skills.name: Inspect Past Runs
skills.description: Downloads and inspects artifacts from past Momentic runs, including test steps and step results, to debug earlier failures.

skills.name: Search Docs
skills.description: Searches the Momentic docs for step options, CLI flags and configuration keys and returns the matching sections with links.
